stations.required_interfaces: Readable card display, keyboard/buttons, immutable receipts, tagged source/task inputs
Separate sheet/stock thickness bins, lot labels, supported cart slots and retainers
Guard, stock/tray docks, job selection/readback, complete and safe_release feedback
Sheet support, pattern readback, hold-downs, guard and safe release
Topology-indexed mat, support jig, face-half clamps, tape/joint tools and waste holders
Supported cradle, defined gauge contacts, camera views and material/identity reader; co-located camera role during relaxation
Opposing-face fixture, calibrated axis/readbacks, force/displacement channels, guard and safe-release interface
Non-actuating support, bimanual contact zones, visible limit feedback and load-off evidence
Keyed channel ports, strain relief, supply-off and residual-pressure-safe readbacks, bounded command controls
Marked carrier slots preserving specimen identity and unsafe-station report
Carrier slots, component trays and immutable raw/derived record links

mobile_robot.embodiment: Human-like mobile manipulator capable of navigation, bimanual support and fine manipulation through qualified interfaces
mobile_robot.mass_reach_grasp_pose: Unresolved; no actual robot capability asserted
transport_preconditions: All tethers detached under safe state
forbidden_shortcuts: Change material or thickness label as a substitute for exchange
Spawn finished specimen from target selection
Move through solid faces or guards
Use one object simultaneously in two stations

active_equipment: All powered manufacturing, compression and pneumatic services are design-level inert proxy roles, never invoked here. Future execution requires qualified interfaces and public limits.
